compose_l05_falsify_hourglass.problem: L-05 appends claims as rnd rows, but nothing on /land shows which claims have never met a falsifier, so an untested claim reads as settled as a checked one. The obvious fixes (age counters, due dates, red escalation) would turn a research ritual into a countdown threat. Needed: a calm, append-only view, derived from existing L-05 rows alone, that greys every unanswered claim as 「待证伪」 until someone brings a source_url + as_of and mints a verify_clear.
do: Host: prefer a lane inside L-05 v2's rolling ledger. If v2 exposes a lane/filter registry, register 'falsify_hourglass' (kinds rnd / verify_clear / method_rev) for placement only, with v2's counts and timestamps switched off inside the lane. If v2 is absent, mount an unnumbered annex as L-05's next sibling on /land: [data-annex='falsify-hourglass'][data-annex-of='L-05'], head 「证伪沙漏」 / 'Falsify Hourglass', sub-line 「附于第五板」 / 'Annex to plate five', no data-plate. Never both. Same loader and same deriveHourglass in either host; when v2 lands the annex unmounts and nothing is written or moved.

Derive, never store: deriveHourglass(rows, now) folds the FULL L-05 history (never v2's rolling window) in append order. Each rnd opens one strip keyed by its immutable row id (fallback: append position), never by content. A strip is 「待证伪」 until a later verify_clear carries claim_ref = that key plus non-empty source_url and as_of; the first such row is cleared_by, later ones are ignored, and state never returns to pending. No status column, cache or second store. To re-test a cleared claim, append a new rnd: it opens its own grey strip and the old seal stays.

One write path: each pending strip has a quiet text button 「呈上证伪」 / 'Offer a falsifier' opening an inline sheet with 「出处链接」 / 'Source link' (http/https with a host, no whitespace, not sentinel), 「所据之时」 / 'As of' (YYYY-MM-DD, a real date, not after today in Asia/Shanghai) and an optional 「可试之问」 / 'A question to try' (§6 prompt). 「落印」 / 'Set the seal' stays disabled until both fields pass, then appends exactly one verify_clear through L-05's existing append. L-05's append hook re-runs the same isQualifyingClear() server-side inside the serialized append and allows one clear per claim_ref (a duplicate submit returns the existing row and appends nothing). Clearing uses L-05's existing append permission; no new role.

method_rev with claim_ref cuts a small V notch into that strip at its term (hover 「方法修订」 / 'Method revised'); without claim_ref it draws one faint hairline across all strips at that term. Neither changes state, before or after a clear.

Synthetic: an rnd with synthetic:true or grade:'S' carries the stamp 「合成 · Grade S」 plus a fine diagonal hatch, identical pending and cleared, in both hosts and in print. The minted verify_clear copies synthetic:true, grade:'S'. Synthetic strips always appear under 「全部」.

Time without digits: ISO instants and as_of stay in the rows. The UI maps them through a bundled 节气 table (Asia/Shanghai, solar-longitude instants, 干支 year turning at 立春) to labels like 「丙午 · 白露」 / 'Bingwu · White Dew'; date-only values resolve at local noon. The as_of picker steps 干支年 → 节气 → 日序 (「首日」「次日」「第三日」 / 'First day' 'Second day' 'Third day'), greys out future terms and writes YYYY-MM-DD.

§6 prompts: prompt_ref keeps the raw id in data only. The UI renders 「可试之问 · §六 · 第三问」 plus the question text (en: 'A question to try · Section six, question three:' plus the text); raw ids live only in data-* attributes. The minted verify_clear carries the sheet's pick, else the rnd's prompt_ref, else no prompt_ref.

Sentinel gate: one shared isSentinelSource(url), used by the sheet, the server hook and the link renderer, refuses paths ending .jsonl / .ndjson (incl. .gz), any 哨兵 / sentinel token after percent-decoding + NFKC, multi-line input and '{'-leading input. On refusal: empty the field, show 「只收出处链接，不收数据流」 / 'A source link only, not a data feed.', never echo the value. Any rendered text field shaped like a JSON(L) payload shows 「此处为数据流，未显示」 / 'Data feed, not shown.' instead.

User text (claim title/summary, §6 question text) renders inside [data-user-text] through guardText → numeralize: URLs, multiplier hype and unambiguous trading tokens (PnL, all-caps LIVE, 必赚, 下单, 盈亏, 行情) mask to 「〔略〕」 / '[withheld]'; digits become 中文数字 or spelled words (「百分之三十五」, 'thirty-five percent'). Raw text stays one tap away via 「在账中查看」 / 'View in ledger'. The hourglass itself never computes or shows a count, ratio or share.

Listing: strips grouped under the 节气 their rnd was raised in; groups newest first, strips in append order within a group; clearing never moves a strip. Filter chips 「全部」「待证伪」「已受检」「合成」 / 'All' 'Awaiting' 'Tested' 'Synthetic' carry no counts. Empty state: 「此刻无断言待证伪」 / 'No claim is awaiting falsification.'

A two-tier CI lint blocks merge across every state, both locales, both hosts and print (patterns in acceptance): tier one over all rendered text including [data-user-text]; tier two over the copy table and chrome (text outside [data-user-text], aria-label, title, alt, placeholder). href and data-* are exempt.
dont: Don't edit, delete, patch, backfill, re-sort or un-clear any L-05 row, and ship no update or delete call path. Corrections are new appended rows.

Don't add a ledger kind (pending, hourglass, claim_status), a status column, a second store or a schema fork between L-05 and v2. Don't number the annex; no L-16+; no /field, /campus or /ethics; nothing off /land.
Don't feed v2's rolling window to derive: an unanswered rnd older than the window stays grey.

Don't imply a timer: no end cap, arrow or target term; no tint or opacity that shifts with age; no red or amber; no falling sand, pulse or upright flip; no age sort or 'oldest' callouts; no reminders, badges, counts, ratios or progress rings.

Don't render Arabic or fullwidth digits, %, ISO dates, raw §6 ids, row ids or URLs in any text, aria-label, title, alt, placeholder, hover card or print. Don't write copy that names the threat in order to deny it.

Don't clear through method_rev, a §6 pick, bulk actions, imports, crawlers or model output, or through a verify_clear missing claim_ref, source_url or as_of. Don't let the read path re-judge content rules: tightening the sentinel list must never re-grey a cleared claim.
Don't word cleared as 已证伪, 已证, 证实, 核实, proven, confirmed or verified. 已受检 means only that a falsifier with a source is on record.
Don't remove, fade, hide or filter out 合成 · Grade S, before or after clearing.

Don't paste, render, quote, preview or accept 哨兵 JSONL anywhere: not in source_url, error text, hover cards or test fixtures (canaries are synthetic strings). Don't fetch or display a source's contents.
No trading surface or language. Ban list: PnL, LIVE, tips, 必赚, 10000x, price(s), order(s), 价格, 下单, 盈亏, 收益, 行情.
compose_l05_falsify_hourglass.visual: Head: 「证伪沙漏」 / 'Falsify Hourglass' (annex sub-line 「附于第五板」) beside a large static hourglass lying on its side, sand level in both bulbs, never turned and never falling; copy.standing_note always visible beneath it (lane mode: the lane's first row, not dismissable). Axis: a thin ruler of equal-width 二十四节气 columns (… 处暑 白露 秋分 寒露 …), the 干支 year written once at each 立春, no dates, numbers or scale legend. At phone width only 四立 and 二分二至 are named and the rest are ticks named on tap; the ruler scrolls inside the plate, opens at the present, and never scrolls the page sideways. A pale-ink hairline 「今 · 白露」 / 'Now · White Dew' marks a place, not a finish line. Pending strip: one flat grey (--hg-pending) from a square start at the rnd's term to the present hairline, right edge feathered open into paper: no cap, no arrow, nothing drawn ahead, and the same grey whether the claim is a day old or years old. Row: side-lying glyph, optional 「合成 · Grade S」 stamp, claim title, chip 「待证伪」, an italic prompt line 「可试之问 · §六 · 第三问 …」 and the quiet button 「呈上证伪」. method_rev: a small V notch on the bar's top edge; the bar stays grey. Cleared: the bar turns paper with a thin ink outline and a closed edge at the clear's term; a square ink seal there carries the as_of term (「丙午 · 白露」); chip 「已受检 · 出处在案」 beside a link that reads only 「出处」 (URL in href, never printed); the glyph stays on its side. Synthetic: fine diagonal hatch plus stamp in both states. Tokens --hg-pending / --hg-paper / --hg-ink / --hg-hatch redefined for dark mode; no red or amber; nothing animates, pulses, flips upright or gets counted. At phone width the annex stacks directly under L-05.
compose_l05_falsify_hourglass.l05_hook: READ: full L-05 history through L-05's existing full-history read, in both hosts; kinds rnd, verify_clear, method_rev; every other kind ignored. KEY: the rnd's immutable L-05 row id (fallback 'seq:' + append position), never derived from content. ADDITIVE OPTIONAL FIELDS on existing kinds only (use L-05's existing names where they exist; map v2 renames at read; write one name per row; rows without them stay valid): rnd {synthetic?, grade?: 'S', prompt_ref?}; verify_clear {claim_ref, source_url, as_of, prompt_ref?, synthetic?, grade?}; method_rev {claim_ref?}. DERIVE (pure fold in append order): V clears R iff V comes after R, V.claim_ref === key(R), and V.source_url and V.as_of are non-empty. This check is structural only; content rules run once, at append. state = cleared if such a V exists, else pending; cleared_by = first V; monotone. method_rev adds a notch (with claim_ref) or a plate-wide hairline (without); no state change. synthetic = R.synthetic === true || R.grade === 'S', read from R alone. APPEND HOOK (server, inside L-05's serialized append, verify_clear rows with claim_ref): isQualifyingClear = http(s) source_url with a host, no whitespace, !isSentinelSource(source_url); as_of matches YYYY-MM-DD, is a real date, and is not after the Asia/Shanghai date of the server append instant; unique per claim_ref (a duplicate returns the existing row and appends nothing); the server assigns id, append instant and sequence and ignores client values; a failing row appends nothing. WRITE (the only one): 「落印」 → L-05 append {kind: 'verify_clear', claim_ref, source_url, as_of, prompt_ref?, synthetic?, grade?}. MOUNT (decided at runtime): v2 lane registry present → registerLane('falsify_hourglass', {kinds: ['rnd','verify_clear','method_rev'], showCounts: false, showTimestamps: false}) and no annex; otherwise the annex beside L-05. Switching hosts writes nothing.
acceptance: Mount/scope: /land holds exactly one of [data-annex='falsify-hourglass'][data-annex-of='L-05'] (L-05's next sibling) or [data-lane='falsify_hourglass']. Lane registry stubbed present ⇒ annex absent; absent ⇒ lane absent; switching appends zero rows. Plate-registry, route-manifest and L-05 kind-enum diffs are empty. The annex has no data-plate and no id starting 'L-', and no text names a plate beyond fifteen.

Lint, over states pending / cleared / synthetic pending / synthetic cleared / notched / sheet open / refusal / hover card / masked text / data-feed placeholder / empty × zh, en × annex, lane × screen, print. Tier one (all textContent incl. [data-user-text]) matches none of /[0-9０-９]/, /[%％]/, /https?:|www\./, /[0-9][0-9,]*\s*[x×]/, /\bPnL\b/i, /\bLIVE\b/, /必赚|下单|盈亏|行情/. Tier two (copy table + chrome + aria-label/title/alt/placeholder; Latin tokens whole-word, case-insensitive) matches none of 剩余|倒计时|截止|到期|过期|仅剩|赶快|紧急|催|限时|逾期; deadline|remaining|left|expir\w*|hurry|urgent|countdown|overdue|timer|last chance; PnL|LIVE|tips|必赚|10000x|prices?|orders?|价格|下单|盈亏|收益|行情; 百分之|percent.

Pending: fixture rnd R1 alone ⇒ [data-claim=R1][data-state=pending], chip text === copy.pending_label[locale], bar fill === resolved --hg-pending in light and dark, right edge [data-hg-edge='open'], no [data-hg-endcap].

Clear: at fixedNow 2026-09-22T12:00:00+08:00, source 'https://example.org/a', picker 丙午 → 白露 → that day's 日序, press 「落印」 ⇒ exactly one verify_clear appended with as_of '2026-09-22'; strip data-state=cleared, chip === copy.cleared_label[locale], seal 「丙午 · 白露」, link text 「出处」 with that href; the URL is absent from textContent; no chip, seal or hover card contains 已证伪, 已证, 证实, 核实, proven, confirmed or verified.

Refusal: each of these keeps 「落印」 disabled in the sheet and is refused with zero rows appended when sent as a direct API append: source_url missing, empty, ftp:, file:, data:, javascript:, hostless, containing whitespace, or matching the sentinel filter; as_of '', '2026-02-30', '2026-9-22', '2026-09-22T10:00:00Z', or after the Shanghai date of the append instant. R1 stays pending after every one.

Derive: raw-seeded verify_clear rows without claim_ref, with another claim's ref, with empty source_url or as_of, or appended before R1 each leave R1 pending. method_rev {claim_ref: R1} ⇒ still pending, exactly one .notch. Adding a token to the sentinel list re-greys no cleared fixture. With a rolling-window stub that supplies only recent rows, an unanswered rnd older than the window still renders pending.

Append-only and unique: snapshot rows around one submit that includes a double-click, a retry and a second-tab submit ⇒ after.slice(0, before.length) deep-equals before and after.length === before.length + 1, with server-assigned id and append instant. Opening, filtering, hovering, picking a prompt and refused submits append zero rows; the session sends zero PUT/PATCH/DELETE; the module contains no L-05 update or delete call. A later raw-seeded clear leaves cleared_by unchanged; a method_rev after clearing adds a notch and data-state stays cleared.
Identity: two rnd rows with identical content ⇒ two strips with distinct data-claim; clearing one leaves the other pending; annex and lane derive identical keys and states from the same history.

Synthetic: an rnd with synthetic:true, and separately one with only grade:'S', each show 「合成 · Grade S」 and the hatch pending and after clearing, in both hosts and print, and appear under 「全部」; the minted verify_clear carries synthetic:true, grade:'S'.

Sentinel: every JSONL-shaped fixture is a synthetic canary (e.g. {"k":"canary-hg"}), never an excerpt of 哨兵 output. Pasting a multi-line JSONL blob, a '{'-leading string, URLs ending .jsonl, .JSONL, .jsonl?download=1, .jsonl.gz or .ndjson/, or URLs containing sentinel, 哨兵 or %E5%93%A8%E5%85%B5 ⇒ nothing appended, field emptied, refusal copy shown, pasted text absent from document.body.textContent. A canary blob as an rnd title renders 「此处为数据流，未显示」.

Time mapping (date-only values at local noon): as_of 2026-09-22 → 「丙午 · 白露」, 2026-09-23 → 「丙午 · 秋分」, 2026-02-03 → 「乙巳 · 大寒」, 2026-02-05 → 「丙午 · 立春」. The hairline reads 「今 · 白露」 at 2026-09-23T07:00:00+08:00 and 「今 · 秋分」 at 2026-09-23T09:00:00+08:00, under harness TZ UTC and Pacific/Auckland alike. With fixedNow 2026-09-22T20:00:00+08:00 and browser TZ Pacific/Auckland, as_of 2026-09-23 is disabled in the picker and refused by the API. No ISO string reaches DOM text.

Age neutrality: R1 raised 2026-09-22; at fixedNow 2028-01-01T12:00:00+08:00, R1 and an rnd raised at that instant have identical computed fill, opacity, stroke, hatch and glyph; nothing is drawn past the present hairline; getAnimations() is empty on strips and glyphs; no role=timer.

§6: an rnd with prompt_ref '§6.q3' shows 「可试之问 · §六 · 第三问」 plus the question text, with the raw id only in data-prompt-ref. Picking a prompt appends nothing. The minted verify_clear carries the sheet's pick if any, else '§6.q3'; with neither, no prompt_ref field is written.

User text: the title 'PnL LIVE 10000x 必赚' renders four masks (「〔略〕」 zh, '[withheld]' en); 'higher-order effects', 'left ventricle' and 'live-cell imaging' render verbatim; '样本覆盖35%' → 「样本覆盖百分之三十五」 and 'coverage 35%' → 'coverage thirty-five percent'; every case passes lint tier one.

standing_note.zh: 灰色是研究的仪式：断言自提出之节气起，静候证伪者。附出处链接与所据之时方可落印，落印只记出处在案，不作定论。
standing_note.en: Grey is a research ritual: each claim rests from the solar term it was raised in, awaiting a falsifier. A source link and an as-of date set the seal, which puts a source on record, not a verdict.

dont_repeat: Append-only: never edit, delete, re-sort or un-clear a row; corrections are new rows.
Derive from the full L-05 history; v2's rolling window never decides 待证伪.
No timer theatre: no end cap, age ramp, red, falling sand or counts, and no copy that names the threat to deny it.
No Arabic digits or % on screen; only 节气 spans, 干支, 中文数字 or spelled-out words.
Cleared is 已受检 · source on record, never 已证伪, 已证, 核实 or proven.
method_rev only notches; a clear is one server-validated verify_clear per claim, keyed by row id, never by content.
合成 · Grade S survives clearing; 哨兵 JSONL never enters the UI, fixtures or source_url.
No new kind, no plate number or L-16+, no /field /campus /ethics, no trading words.
open_questions: verify_clear 要不要区分「经受住」与「被推翻」？本规格默认不区分：落印只记「出处在案」，被推翻的论断走 method_rev + 新 rnd。若 Founder 要在灰条上显出结局，需在 verify_clear 上加可选 outcome 字段，并补一条 cleared_label 变体。
